tasks.objective_text_zh: 龙骨荒野龙眠神殿的克拉苏斯要你取回魔法之心。 /  / 该任务必须在英雄模式下的25人永恒之眼中完成。
tasks.objective_text_en: Krasus atop Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight wants you to return with the Heart of Magic. /  / This quest is for the Heroic mode, 25-person version of The Eye of Eternity.

tasks.name: 神谕者孤儿鲁鲁
tasks.english_name: Little Orphan Roo Of The Oracles

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_zh: 同孤儿监护员艾蕊娅交谈，然后使用神谕者孤儿哨召唤你要在儿童周照顾的孤儿。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Orphan Matron Aria, then use the Oracle Orphan Whistle to call the orphan you will be taking care of during Children's Week.

tasks.name: 狼獾人孤儿科科

tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Orphan Matron Aria, then use the Wolvar Orphan Whistle to call the orphan you will be taking care of during Children's Week.

tasks.name: 青铜巨龙圣地

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_zh: 带上你的孤儿鲁鲁前往青铜巨龙圣地。如果当你到达那里的时候，他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
tasks.objective_text_en: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit the Bronze Dragonshrine. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.

tasks.name: 青铜巨龙圣地

tasks.objective_text_zh: 带上你的孤儿科科前往青铜巨龙圣地。如果当你到达那里的时候，他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
tasks.objective_text_en: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit the Bronze Dragonshrine. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.

tasks.name: 伙伴！

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_zh: 带着你的孤儿科科前往飘雪林地。当你到达那里的时候，如果他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
tasks.objective_text_en: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit Snowfall Glade. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.

tasks.name: 龙眠之灾

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往龙骨荒野，和龙眠神殿中的克拉苏斯交谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Krasus at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

tasks.name: 突袭红玉圣殿

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_zh: 调查龙眠神殿之下的红玉圣殿。
tasks.objective_text_en: Investigate the Ruby Sanctum beneath Wyrmrest Temple.

tasks.name: 暮光毁灭者

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_zh: 击败海里昂和入侵红玉圣殿的敌人。
tasks.objective_text_en: Defeat Halion and repel the invasion of the Ruby Sanctum.
